tasks.instruction_text: I'm scoping a Azure workload for a customer in East US — set up a quote for Azure OpenAI — GPT-4o, override the default usage to 5M input + 5M output tokens for the month, and pin the Standard tier since this is a regulated tenant.

Could you put together a Virtual Machines (D-series) quote? Always-on 1-month workload — use 730 VM-hours (1 month always-on) — and bill it out of East US 2, the Developer tier is fine, we don't need anything fancier.
Need to estimate Azure Blob Storage sitting in Central US at about 500 GB storage. We're on the Basic tier anyway.
Configure the calculator for Azure SQL Database in West US 2 — usage around 100 DTU-hours per month and we're already on the Professional Direct tier for the FedRAMP tenant.
What's the projected monthly bill for Azure Functions in West US 3 doing 5M function executions, with the Basic tier attached?
Quick check — if I put 10 TB storage through Bandwidth (egress) in US Gov Virginia, on the None tier, what does the monthly estimate come to?
Hmm, what would Azure OpenAI — GPT-4o cost me in Brazil South for a 5M input + 5M output tokens monthly commitment if I add the Standard tier on top? Just want the number.

Pricing exercise for a finance review: configure the calculator for Azure SQL Database in Canada Central, override usage to 100 DTU-hours, leave support at the Basic tier, then tell me the all-in monthly total — they want it for the budget doc.

OK so I need to estimate Virtual Machines (D-series) running in West Europe for one month — use 730 VM-hours (1 month always-on) — and we're on the Developer tier; set it up in the calculator and give me the monthly figure.

Hey, can you set up an estimate for 10 TB storage out of North Europe on Bandwidth (egress) and tell me the monthly cost? We're on the Basic tier, but if it's over $1000/month we'll probably want to revisit.
